About Us:  

HighRadius is a pioneering, India-based autonomous finance platform that transforms the Office of the CFO for global enterprises. It automates core financial processes like Order-to-Cash, Record to Report, Accounts Payable, and Treasury. Operating at massive scale, HighRadius serves 1,300+ customers in 90+ countries, including giants like Redbull, Nike, Adobe, Unilever, Service Now, Warner Bro, L’Oreal, P&G, Nestle, and many more. In 2025 alone, the platform automated $25 trillion in invoices—a volume equivalent to 70% of the US GDP.

Recognized as an undisputed market leader by Gartner, IDC, and the Hackett Group, HighRadius pairs global reach with deep R&D. Its 20+ product suite leverages proprietary AI like FreedaGPT, LiveCube, and 180+ orchestrated autonomous agents. Backed by 37 patents, the 2024 SaaSBoomi "SaaS Startup of the Year" sets the global standard for financial AI while uniquely committing to contractual business outcomes for its clients.

Job Title: Agent Product Builder 

Role Overview 

In this role, you will be working on the following key problems:

  • End-to-End Agent Development: Build, orchestrate, and deploy autonomous AI agents to drive 90%+ automation across Office of the CFO functions for Fortune 500 clients.
  • Big Finance data transformation: HighRadius sits atop the world's most complex financial data; through world’s leading financial data transformation platform: LiveCube
  • Deliver measurable value to Fortune 500 clients through Predictive forecasting, work optimization & prioritization, Anomaly identification, etc., leveraging Patent backed AI/ML algorithms.
  • Unstructured Data processing: Custom Algos for Matching, Reconciliations, Parsing etc. core financial process which beat industry’s models by 50%+. 

The role is based out of the Hyderabad location. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Agent Development: Independently design, code, and deploy autonomous agents from scratch to automate critical Office of the CFO workflows. 
  • Applied Data Science: Leverage Data Analytics for predictive forecasting, anomaly detection, and data reconciliation, directly impacting Fortune 500 clients.
  • Performance Visualization: Design clear, intuitive data visualizations and tracking dashboards to continuously monitor agent health, prove out the 90%+ automation metrics, and communicate your product's impact to senior stakeholders.
  • Full-Lifecycle Ownership: Operate as a self-contained builder. You will be writing product requirements; you will develop from the first line of code and model training to final deployment and iteration.
  • Algo first thinking: Dive deep into massive, complex financial datasets. Write algos to solve NP Hard problems (Think Knapsack, or Mixed Integer Linear Programming but on Petabytes of Data).
  • High-Intensity Execution: Thrive in a demanding, results-driven culture that values a "no excuses" mentality, speed of execution, and extreme dedication to hitting ambitious milestones and KPIs.

Requirements 

  • Apply first principles thinking to break down and solve ambiguous problems
  • Must possess Technical acumen and system design knowledge.
  • Excellent Academic record from a top tier IIT
  • Technical skills required - Functional Programming language (Pref. Rust), OOP (Python or Java), Distributed syst
